# Pull Request Summary

Please provide a clear summary of the proposed change and why it is needed.

## What changed?

Describe the files, modules, workflows, or documentation updated in this pull request.

## Why is this change required?

Explain the problem being addressed or the improvement being introduced.

## How was it tested?

Please describe the tests performed, including unit, integration, regression, security, or manual checks where relevant.

## Security and privacy impact

- Does this change affect authentication, authorisation, access control, logging, configuration, dependencies, or sensitive data handling?
- Does it introduce any new external service or dependency?
- Does it use only synthetic, de-identified, properly licensed, or otherwise suitable public test data?

## Documentation

Confirm whether the README, docs, examples, configuration guidance, or release notes require updates.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have kept this pull request focused.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] All relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] I have not committed patient-identifiable information, credentials, secrets, or restricted data.
- [ ] I have reviewed security and privacy implications.
- [ ] I have updated documentation where required.
- [ ] I understand that maintainers retain final approval for all changes.
